title: Hister: A private search engine for the pages you visit and the files you keep
summary: Hister is an open-source private search engine that indexes the web pages you visit and files you keep locally, offering full-text search over personal browsing history and documents without sending data to external servers. It is a self-hosted tool aimed at privacy-conscious users, discussed extensively on Hacker News with 637 points and 171 comments.
